title: Great, but short string
text: Great, but short string. These lights are good but have very short strands so make sure you need these for a small project.

product_metadata.title: 15 Packs Fairy String Lights, 6.6FT 20 LED Battery Operated Silver Copper Wire Starry String Light for DIY Party Christmas Costume Wedding Easter Table Decorations (Blue)
features: ✨PACK OF 15 UNITS - 15 pack LED Fairy String lights are mainly made of high quality 3.9in long flexible silver coated copper wires, with 20 Micro LED Beads.2 x CR2032 batteries per lights and a screwdriver included.

✨Easy To Shape - With flexible and extra thin but sturdily built silver wires, the led string fairy lights can be easily bend, twist and mould into any shapes that you desire. Perfect to decorate wedding, party, Christmas, jars, vases, wine bottles, planting, etc.
✨Battery Operated - The fairy string lights battery operated with on off switch, powered by 2 * CR2032 battery (included).72 Hours of battery life, Please replaced batteries when the lights get dim.
✨Safe and energy-saving - The soft warm lights remains low voltage which is safe to the touch. No light pollution,energy-saving and environmental protection, in order to protect all of your vision.
✨Waterproof - The led mini string lights is waterproof (battery box not), can be put into water to create an amazing atmosphere ,widely used indoors and outdoors.
